description: Injected keyboard taps exit the original terminal; Windows Home recreates a usable terminal after it has closed.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: 180 degree rotation and full-to-limited range conversion; original camera clip retained
site_assets.screenshot_source: grim on the physical board, transferred over serial

review.video_probe: H.264, yuv420p, limited range, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 28.000 seconds, 840 frames
review.visual_review: Reviewed camera frames near 1, 8, 15, and 23 seconds: terminal activity, closure, recovery menu, and recovered terminal are visible. Camera glare and the oblique view soften text; native screenshots are readable.
review.interaction_state: Injected uinput closed the original terminal and used Windows/Home to recover it; camera proves panel display, not real finger touch.
